Saved on public `launch-program`; main and `v0-overnight` are unchanged. This is a development checkpoint, not launch ready. No publication, Dashboard, sales, live DataStore or place-setting changes. Root alone runs Studio/builds/git; agents own combat, presentation and world, coordinate contracts and peer-review.

**Closed evidence / implemented engineering:** M0 five-run baseline; M1 original cast/story/source IP migration (owner approval open); M2 AI engineering; M5 hub/party/admission/return with fake-adapter and earlier Studio fixtures. M3 persistent survival, style/rank/reward accounting, risk actions, six Heat effects and three earned-only trade-off boons have scoped policy/runtime/UI evidence. All M4 launch features remain required and unimplemented. Money never buys power.

**Before/after:** M0 Normal5/5,mean278.27s/0.80stocks/543damage; M2 Normal5/5,398.56s/2.80stocks/830.4damage. M2 pooled idle16.10%to9.58%,flank45.45%to96.43%,cap breaches0;351 accepted hits audited0outside/invalid. Final M3 reviewed trials: Normal: **1/5 clears**, mean459.27s/4.60stocks/1031.8floored damage; Hard: **0/5 clears**, mean403.09s/4.60stocks/977.4floored damage; Nightmare: **0/5 clears**, mean315.23s/4.20stocks/879.6floored damage. All15 frozen trials are now complete; each unfavorable trial is preserved. Normal1/5 and Hard0/5 fail their planned3–4/5 and2/5 targets; Nightmare0/5 meets its under20% target. Overall curve acceptance remains failed. Detailed per-trial data are in the WO-3.7 row and evidence files.

All15 trials use fresh solo Gale/Guardian Practice,no Heat,seeds1101–1105 and unchanged bot actions. Installed campaign fixtures and both artifacts remain frozen. Root released bounded M6 input-layout source preparation and observation-only AI diagnostics on disk during the wait; the15-trial series is finished and Studio is now Edit; root may install reviewed newer source for a separately labeled verification batch. Normal1101 lacks the later passive camera-motion observer. Camera pooled statistics include noncombat/terminal frames and unresolved offscreen hero samples; no comfort verdict.

**Implemented but acceptance open:** tier/rank curve tuning and final-M3 co-op/lifecycle/latency regression. Updated six test fixtures are peer-reviewed but unrun; exact commands in `tests/MultiplayerLifecycle.md`. Actual M3 two-client revive/Heat/risk fixtures passed their stated scopes. Nine OriginalCast2 inspection/idle captures and city/factory combat stills are reviewed, but action/crowd/clipping/device art acceptance is incomplete. M2 action diversity passed21/31 eligible crowd windows (target failed); desktop AI CPU mean0.46067ms does not prove phone performance. Shared active-input/short-height HUD fixes are implemented and pushed at e64e499, with seven pure suites passed; actual widget/Main and hardware verification remain pending. Observation-only AI opportunity diagnostics are pushed at35610ee, with26purechecks and three regression suites passed; live diagnostics remain unrun. SEC03 movement-origin enforcement remains unimplemented.

**Next sequence:** complete frozen aggregate now reviewed (dataPASS/curveFAIL); install committed e64e499 source (exclude pending city palette), run InputReadabilityClient plus actual Main inspection, then latest multiplayer/lifecycle tests; choose a measured tuning experiment (NormalWindupScale1.00to1.10 is a reviewed proposal only), verify results, then implement M4. M6 movement-origin adversarial test preparation was stopped by an automated possible-cybersecurity-risk check; it remains unrun and SEC03 open. A partial client fixture is excluded from production and must not be executed as a complete test. Keep UI and security fixes separate from the frozen gameplay measurement.

**Blocked / owner decisions:** real teleport round trips, live persistence and same-account reconnect require a configured published test universe, prohibited overnight. Physical phone/controller and human Normal/Hard/Nightmare sessions are unavailable to agents. Owner must approve candidate names Gale/Rook Calder,Piston/Bo Marlowe,Tide/Isla Veyra and art, select the minimum phone, and configure the isolated universe later. See `LAUNCH_REPORT.md` and [notes index](launch/README.md); prior handoff detail is preserved in [history](launch/HANDOFF_HISTORY.md).

**Latest camera limitation:** Nightmare1105 camera capture continued about232.47s after defeat;13,949/31,396frames were Defeat. Do not pool its15,125quiet pairs as gameplay-only smoothness. Preserve the report; the bot outcome,73accepted-hit frustum receipts and reward reconciliation remain valid. Actual human comfort is unverified. City-only palette source is independently reviewed but uncommitted/unrendered; exclude it from the initial e64e499 UI verification and compare separately.
